items: JSDoc audit, chunk 4/7 — filtering/sorting (runFilter, testRowMatch, multi-sort, tint registry, column-header collapse).

getColFilters(): added a missing JSDoc (found while fixing testRowMatch's doc below, since it needed getColFilters()' real descriptor shapes to be accurate) — this ~125-line function had none, despite being the sole builder of the colFilters array testRowMatch() consumes on every filter pass.

testRowMatch(): @param ctx.colFilters was typed only as the plain-text-filter shape ({ val, idx }), completely omitting the checkbox/multi-value-filter shape (isMultiValueFilter, valueSet, hasItemValues, hasEntityValues, structureModes) that getColFilters() also produces and that a large fraction of the function's own matching logic branches on. Documented both shapes explicitly.

Removed an orphaned duplicate JSDoc block (lines 16840-16872, ~33 lines) describing updateSubTableCollapseButton() in full, sitting directly above _COLLAPSE_MATCH_SEL's own doc with no function in between. The real updateSubTableCollapseButton() is defined ~1450 lines later and already has its own correct, accurate doc.

Added a full missing JSDoc to runFilter() — despite being one of the two functions named directly in this chunk's own title, and ~680 lines long (reads filter UI state, builds testRowMatch's matchCtx, branches single-/multi-table with an incremental-scan cache optimisation, rebuilds the DOM, re-wires every post-filter hook, restores scroll/focus, and updates the status displays), it had zero documentation.

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 3/7 — unique-values dropdown (SYN_SECTION_META, section rendering, structure-mode matchers, highlight functions, quickfilter). Cleanest chunk audited so far: no orphaned/misattributed blocks and no missing JSDoc found.

_cellMatchesStructureMode(): @param mode's union type listed only 16 of the ~35 mode strings/prefixes the function's own dispatch chain actually recognizes. Replaced the exhaustive-but-incomplete union with a pointer to the dispatch chain as the source of truth (with a representative sample), to stop the doc drifting out of sync again as new modes are added.

openUniqDrop(): top-level doc claimed clicking/Enter on an entry 'copies only the raw column value... into the corresponding column filter input' — a single-value, close-on-select model. Wrong: the real handler toggles a checkbox and re-applies the whole checked set via applyUniqValueSet(), and the panel stays open for continued multi-select — exactly as the function's own nested renderItems() closure already correctly documented a few hundred lines down. The two docs on the same code directly contradicted each other; fixed the outer one to match.
makeSynItem(): @param mode's union was missing 4 real values actually passed at call sites: 'multi-medium', 'catalog-has-prefix', 'catalog-no-prefix', 'catalog-none'.
makeValueSynItem(): @param kind's union was missing 3 real values actually passed at call sites: 'tagcount', 'entitycancelled', 'eventcancelled'.
applyUniqValueSet(): cosmetic fix — rejoined a JSDoc sentence that had an odd mid-sentence line break.

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 2/7 — CAA/EAA illustrated discography (queue, icon/inline/bigbox loading, IDB cache, cache-hint telemetry).

Art Archive IndexedDB cache section banner: said 'version: 1' with only the 'images'/'metadata' stores; the DB is actually at version 2 with a third store, 'rel-ws2' (added for the Relationships column's own L2 cache). Documented the third store's shape and clarified it shares this database purely for one common sweep/count/clear code path.

_artIdbGet()/_artIdbPut(): @param storeName documented as 'images' | 'metadata' only, missing 'rel-ws2' which both are actually called with elsewhere (their siblings _artIdbDelete/_artIdbCountStore already documented all three correctly).
_artLoadIcon(): added a missing prose summary — the doc jumped straight into @param tags with no description of what the function does (three-tier cache-hit thumbnail load + cache-hint decoration).

_artInitInlinePics(): @param ctx was documented with an ad hoc inline shape ({ key, addFeature, fetchUrl, archiveBase }) that doesn't match the real ArtCtx typedef at all (no fetchUrl/archiveBase property exists) and omitted properties the function actually reads (inlinePh, inlineDoneAttr, inlineLinkSel, entityTypes, archiveHost). Replaced with the standard @param {ArtCtx} ctx used by every sibling _art* function.

Removed an orphaned JSDoc block (a full 'Generic inline-thumbnail feature' doc, ~28 lines) sitting directly above _wireInlineThumbnailBigboxTooltip() — a different function entirely. Its real target, _artInitInlinePics(), is ~230 lines further down and already has its own doc (fixed above).

Added missing JSDoc to _renderBigboxTooltipFromColumns() (~220 lines, 2 external call sites, previously fully undocumented) and fixed its declaration line's indentation (8 leading spaces instead of the file's standard 4 for a top-level function).

sections.label: 📖 Documentation
items: JSDoc audit, chunk 1/7 — core render pipeline (ColumnDataExtractor/SyntheticColumnDataExtractor registries, the buildActive* family, startFetchingProcess, renderFinalTable, renderGroupedTable, finalCleanup).

applyColumnErasers(): doc claimed 'two distinct strategies' and listed only 4 of the function's 5 actual erasure strategies (missing the wiencek suggested-work/work div strategy entirely, and mislabeling the expand-events strategy's number). Rewrote to document all 5 in their actual order, including the jesus2099 own-cell 'treleases' class/style stripping that was undocumented.

buildActiveIntegerColumns()/applyIntegerColumnStyling()/finalizeSplitAlignedColumns(): docs described the split-align feature as ':'-only (colon-specific), when the code accepts any single character as the split separator. Also fixed 'splits at the FIRST occurrence' → actually splits at the LAST occurrence (deliberate, for values like '[H:]M:S'), and renamed the finalizeSplitAlignedColumns() doc header from its old name finalizeColonAlignedColumns (stale after a prior rename — same failure shape as the v9.99.366 misattributed-JSDoc bug, though this one was at least still attached to the correct function). Also documented that min-width is set on BOTH the .mb-ic-left and .mb-ic-right spans, not just the left one.

renderFinalTable(): doc's steps 4-7 (sort re-wiring, filter/visibility reapply, sticky headers/column, row-count tooltip) don't happen inside this function at all — they're the caller's responsibility (startFetchingProcess calls them immediately after). Rewrote to describe the function's actual 6 steps, including the render-generation guard and the deliberate skip of initAreaFlagRegionObserver().

finalCleanup(): doc claimed it 'removes stale sanojjonas/jesus2099 container IDs' (jesus2099 removal doesn't exist in this function) and was missing 5 real tasks it performs (editor-subscribers row/paragraph patching, artist-releases VA-footer node removal, Credits h3 collapsibility, list-merge-buttons-row-container hiding, filter-bar visibility sync) plus the plural removeSelectors variant. Rewrote the full task list in actual execution order.
renderGroupedTable(): fixed @param {string} query to the file's established [name=default] convention: @param {string} [query=''].

Removed an orphaned duplicate JSDoc block (lines 4547-4553) sitting directly above a second, more complete JSDoc block for buildActiveInjectedColumns() — a short superseded draft with no function of its own beneath it.

Removed an orphaned floating comment inside finalCleanup() (the 'Plus N other anonymous users' 4-step description) that was misplaced between the user-subscriptions and release-collections blocks; the real editor-subscribers code ~75 lines below already carries its own correct, numbered inline comments describing the same steps.
